reviews.summary: Suggested using vm_normal_folio_pmd() directly and minimizing checks on the expected path, making the code more efficient.

2026-08-21.patch_summary: This patch series addresses a bug in the mm/mempolicy code, specifically in the queue_folios_pmd function. The issue arises when dealing with VM_PFNMAP regions and huge zero PMDs, causing the folio to land in unpopulated vmemmap and leading to incorrect behavior. The patch uses vm_normal_folio_pmd() instead of pmd_folio(), which correctly handles these cases and prevents the bug.
